source.text:
4. A straight-line is (any) one which lies evenly with
points on itself.

source_claims.requirement: Relate the straight-line concept to the approved general line concept.

source_claims.source_quote: lies evenly with points on itself
source_claims.requirement: Give a meaningful representation of evenness involving points on that same line.

interpretation_decisions.question: What exact analytic relation interprets lies evenly?
How will straight and non-straight line representations be distinguished?

review_failure_probes: A universally true predicate or self-equality disconnected from line geometry does not establish source correspondence.
